text:
alex: quick thread to capture the partner-bento quickstart idea. goal: a tiny repo partners can clone and deploy in <30m. artifacts:
1) composable Terraform modules (network + compute + iam)
2) Helm chart + minimal demo container that hits an inference proxy
3) CI smoke pipeline (tf plan, helm lint, container scan)
4) local run script + lightweight traffic generator

tanya: love it. make TF composable not opinionated. split into modules so partners can pick just compute or just networking. default_vars should be sane but overrideable.

jorge: i can take TF work. proposal: keep interface small: env, region, provider map, instance_profile. example usage:
```hcl
module "partner_net" {
  source = "github.com/redwood/partner-bento//terraform/network?ref=init"
  env    = "partner-accel"
  providers = { aws = aws, google = google }
}
```

mei: marketplace/partner teams will require metadata files: listing.yaml, manifest for runtimes, SBOM for containers, and provenance info. also add SBOM generation in CI.

ci-bot: CI pipeline queued: branch=partner/bento-init  steps=[terraform-init, terraform-plan, helm-lint, trivy-scan]

alex: jorge, for compute module add a toggle for gpu_profile (none | t4 | a100) and quantized=true/false. doc should map quantized->recommended CPU/GPU + memory.

jorge: noted. we'll add a small lookup map in README with recommended instance types per cloud.

tanya: docs need a partner checklist: required IAM roles, expected latency baseline, test credentials format, and a short troubleshooting section. also include CONTRIBUTING.md and a CLA note for partner-provided patches.

mei: container strategy: small demo app (node/nginx) + proxy that hits a stub Redwood inference endpoint. runtime image must be small (<150MB) and derived from distroless. include SBOM and attestations.

alex: local run helper idea: `scripts/run_local.sh` that builds images, applies minimal TF (using local backend or Dockerized terraform), and runs `curl` traffic to validate. sample traffic generator: `scripts/loadgen.py` (100 reqs, 1 QPS).

jorge: quick sketch for run_local.sh:
```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -e
./scripts/build_images.sh
terraform init -backend=false ./terraform/demo
terraform apply -auto-approve ./terraform/demo
helm install partner-demo ./chart --wait
./scripts/loadgen.py --count 100 --qps 1
```

mei: also add release artifact signing for marketplace packages and a CHANGELOG template. partners ask for verifiable builds.

ci-bot: static-analysis step passed. trivy reported one low severity in base image.

alex: timeline: RFC by end of week, repo scaffold next Tue, POC to 2 pilot partners in 3 weeks. owners: jorge=terraform, mei=packaging + SBOM, tanya=docs + legal checklist, alex=repo + coordination.

tanya: i'll create ISSUE templates and PR checklist including steps: run smoke CI locally, attach SBOM, sign release.

jorge: one more: add a tiny acceptance test that verifies env vars and returns a sample inference-style response (json shape). will make partner onboarding verification easier.

mei: i'll prepare a sample listing.yaml for GCP and Azure marketplace formats so partners can preview.

alex: scheduling 30m sync tomorrow to align on CI matrix and region/instance matrix. will drop calendar invite. GH repo: github.com/redwood/partner-bento (will be private until preview). :calendar:
